name: Leading Children Astray
overview: Scripture emphasizes the preciousness of children in the kingdom of heaven, as Jesus welcomes and values them (Matthew 18:5, 19:14). At the same time, it sternly warns against leading these little ones astray, declaring severe judgment on those who cause them to stumble in their faith (Matthew 18:6). False teachers disguised as harmless can deceive and harm the spiritual well-being of children and believers alike (Matthew 7:15), highlighting the grave responsibility to protect the young from spiritual harm. The sorrow of losing children to other influences is also foreshadowed in Deuteronomy 28:32, underscoring the lasting consequences of straying from God's truth.
